tips-avaliableMargins: Margin available for opening positions; Available Margin = Available Balance
tips-marginRatio: Margin Ratio: The margin ratio is calculated as Net Value / Margin Balance.  Liquidation: The platform's liquidation threshold is 10%. When your Net Value / Margin Balance falls below this ratio, liquidation will be triggered.  In cross-margin mode, all positions will be liquidated simultaneously instead of individually to release the occupied margin. The final remaining margin will depend on market conditions and volatility at the time.

tips-referenceMargin: The Reference Margin is a fixed benchmark margin value set by the system to estimate the maximum order amount a user can place in a single order in advance. It serves only as a pre-estimate before placing an order and is not the margin that will actually be deducted.
tips-unrealisedPnl: Unrealized PnL = Sum of floating profit/loss on current positions
